# Repository Instructions

This repository is a Markdown guidance corpus, not an application source tree.

Before substantive work:

- Read the repository [README](../README.md) to understand its purpose and current objective.
- For people-facing guidance, apply the [People-Centred Documentation Style](../.agent-work/documentation/writing-style.md).
- For agent work, apply the [Agent Workflow Conventions](../agents/conventions/documentation/agent-workflow.md) and the relevant convention group under [Agent Guidance](../agents/readme.md).
- Treat the user's current request as the immediate objective, and preserve the distinction between accessible explanation and compact agent rules.

Reader guidance should explain the subject before describing routes, folders or document mechanics. Do not make readers learn the repository structure before they understand why the material matters.

Every non-index Markdown page should provide a clear link back to its immediate folder README. Every folder README should provide a clear link to its parent README, except the repository root. Use the local navigation convention in the writing-style and documentation guidance rather than inventing a new pattern.

Preserve unrelated worktree changes. After editing, validate local Markdown links and inspect the changed documents and their neighbouring index pages.
